answer: Each agent identity carries one on-chain work record as its anchor, and that record grows only through verified jobs, so a newcomer cannot buy history. A falcon audit team re-runs a random sample of each agent's recent jobs every day; a copied or faked job fails the re-run and burns the whole bond. To pass, an attacker would need 200 fake identities, each with 100 real-looking jobs and a 50-coin bond, costing 10,000 coins plus 20,000 hours of compute, while one failed audit triggers a spiral of re-checks across all its linked accounts, wiping the entire clone farm at once.
